items.title: Meta Ads: $349.76 spend, 24 leads, $14.57 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Catch-up window 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-19 (7 days, capped — see needs_attention) spent $349.76, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 24 leads at $14.57 CPL. That's roughly in line with the trailing 7-day baseline (2026-09-06 to 2026-09-12: $349.68 / 26 leads, ~$13.45 CPL, about 8% lower CPL) — well under the 2x anomaly threshold. Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged DISAPPROVED/WITH_ISSUES.

needs_attention: This branch's ingest/ history only has a prior meta-ads.json through 2026-09-08 (covering 2026-09-07) — a 12-day gap to today. Per the known recurring branch-isolation issue, vault daily notes 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-19 indicate Meta Ads actually ran most of those days on separate unmerged session branches, so this is very likely not a real coverage gap in the underlying data. Per this agent's capped catch-up logic, today's pull widened to the 7-day maximum (2026-09-13 to 2026-09-19) rather than the true 12-day gap — 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-12 remains unrepresented in this branch's meta-ads.json history and was not re-pulled.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 24 over the window, matching the counted leads exactly, same pattern flagged on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, and 2026-09-07/08). No discrepancy in the counted total, but this keeps recurring — the script's LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
